cards.mood: The piece opens with a somber, reflective atmosphere established by a solitary melodic line, which deepens as the vocals enter with a storytelling quality.
cards.palette: A clean electric guitar with a slight twang serves as the central melodic voice, introducing the main theme in the intro and weaving counter-melodies throughout the verses and choruses.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, wistful atmosphere established by slide guitar, maintaining a restrained and intimate tone through the verses.
cards.palette: A clean electric guitar utilizing a heavy slide technique serves as the melodic anchor, present from the Intro through the Outro, often answering the vocal phrases with mournful, gliding lines.
